2104-4423-6886-8344.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
2104-4423-6886-8344.notablePrerequisites: Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
2104-4423-6886-8344.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

2034-4772-5220-6961-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4772-5220-6961-8347.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Sela triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

4186-4279-6720.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-6720.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

5541-5571-8249--6.description:
Use Bazaar Trader to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat from step 2.

3755-4770-5295-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3899-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
3899-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Repeat from step 3.

728-2466-3249-3621.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5686-6273.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Embalmed Ascendant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with two +1/+1 counters on it

1597-3457-7791.description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Gyre Sage.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Gyre Sage.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1061-4603-5434.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
1061-4603-5434.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
1061-4603-5434.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

4050-4681-5170-6772.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Syr Vondam triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

997-2595--5.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2103-4863-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Revolutionist
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-4742-5256.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4742-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

791-3693-5426-7186.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3693-5426-7186.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
Cast Injury by paying {2}{R}.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3.

262-2266-5231.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by tapping it, creating three 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing two Elementals, adding {R}{R} that is snow mana.
Activate Phyrexian Ironfoot by paying {1}{S}, untapping it.
Repeat.

292-4968-7061.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-4968-7061.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3188-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3188-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4067-6072-6281.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Graveshifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Graveshifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Graveshifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat.

2751-3649-5334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
2751-3649-5334.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability twice due to Roaming Throne.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying either of Etrata's triggers.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

1330-1640-4083.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Truefire Captain.
Truefire Captain is indestructible.
1330-1640-4083.description:
Deal damage to Truefire Captain.
Truefire Captain and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Truefire Captain trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Truefire Captain instead of you due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat from step 2.

1494-1742-6822-6838.description:
If you have more than three cards in hand, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have three or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Doctor Octopus triggers, causing you to draw at least five cards.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

304-4222-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
304-4222-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
304-4222-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

3967-6188-6591--85.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
3967-6188-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Fear of Missing Out as attackers.
Fear of Missing Out's second ability triggers, untapping Squall and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat each combat phase.

2043-3129-6252.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Boommobile that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
When the Boommobile tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2043-3129-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1355-3812-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two enchantments.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1355-3812-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Sanctum Weaver's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

784-1750-2793-5261-5330.notablePrerequisites: Silas Renn cannot be blocked by an opponent.
784-1750-2793-5261-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Silas Renn, triggering Silas Renn, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2445-3933-4929-5479.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2445-3933-4929-5479.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting a charge counter on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

230-560-3002-4050.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a card in exile.
230-560-3002-4050.description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard.
The card is instead put back into exile due to Rest in Peace.
Resolve the Void Attendant ability, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion and Soldier, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

486-1978-4667.description:
Cause Elvish Aberration to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Repeat from step 2.

681-1637-4423-4693-4826.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest and two additional lands.
Archelos is untapped.
681-1637-4423-4693-4826.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and two other lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Overgrown Estate four times by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and two other lands, causing you to gain 12 life.
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When each land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary triggers once.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Splendid Reclamation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Repeat.
If you control additional lands, you may sacrifice them as well to get additional mana and triggers.

1545-3263-4050-4078-4242.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1545-3263-4050-4078-4242.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding one mana of any color.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

2034-4013-4749.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Somberwald Beastmaster.
When Somberwald Beastmaster enters, it triggers, creating three creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-2097-2972-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ganax, adding {C}{C}.
Ganax dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Ganax from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Ganax enters the battlefield, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

30-141-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-141-2034.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Storm of Souls.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Storm of Souls
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-141-2034.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

321-399-1739-2475-4648.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
Metallic Sliver enters the battlefield, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 1 life.
Essence Sliver triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
